findings.evidence: "move PROJ-27 to done after checking its available transitions"; also "update the summary of PROJ-18 after fetching its current details" and "add a comment to ticket OPS-92 but show me before posting". findings.evidence: "the available transitions for a move (names and ids differ per workflow; if the target is not in the list, propose a full multi-hop route only from a trusted workflow graph (for example MCP `getJiraWorkflows`, disabled by default); otherwise show ... re-read after each); CLI-only setups list transitions through REST ... (mcp.md, Transitions); the required fields ...". The branches for edit, move, multi-hop, CLI-only and create sit in one nested sentence.
